feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 12:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe with low pressure to the south of Greenland, bringing a moist warm sector across the area.


##Wind##

South or southwest mainly 4 or 5, but occasionally 3 or less in the southeast of the area, falling 3 or 4 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, but smooth in the far southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, especially in the west of the area. Then occasional rain for a time this evening, clearing to become mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, increasing mainly 4 or 5 Saturday afternoon but becoming variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate. Remaining smooth in the far southeast of the area throughout the period.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
